$comment: Pack model for Pokemon TCG: Mega Evolution - Ascended Heroes (me2pt5).
Every probability here is sourced, not invented. See 'sources' below and
docs/PULL-RATES.md for the full derivation and the arithmetic that shows
this slot model reproduces the published per-pack rates exactly.

godPack.rateNote: Community-estimated at roughly 1 in 950-1000 packs. NOT part of the TCGplayer study, which explicitly excluded god packs.

slots.label: Reverse Holo
slots.$comment: First of the two reverse-holo slots introduced in the Scarlet & Violet pack configuration. Always a reverse holo.

slots.label: Reverse Holo / Illustration Rare
slots.$comment: Second reverse-holo slot. PokeBeach: 'If you pull either an Illustration Rare or a Special Illustration Rare they will take the place of the second reverse holo slot.'

slots.label: Holo / Rare
slots.$comment: The guaranteed-holo slot. Falls through to a Holo Rare when no higher rarity is rolled.

assumptions.text: Mega Attack Rares are placed in the holo/hit slot rather than the second reverse-holo slot. MARs are full-art Mega Pokemon ex, i.e. members of the ultra-rare family, while the reverse slot is documented to be taken by the illustration-style secret rares (IR/SIR). No source states the MAR slot explicitly.
assumptions.impact: Per-pack marginal rates are identical either way and match the published figures exactly. Only the joint distribution differs: with this choice a Mega Attack Rare and a Double Rare cannot appear in the same pack.
assumptions.howToChange: Move the MEGA_ATTACK_RARE entry from slots[hit].outcomes into slots[rh2].upgrades. No code change needed.

assumptions.text: The god pack rate of 1/1000 is a community estimate, not a measured figure. God packs were excluded from the TCGplayer study, so the per-rarity rates above are conditional on a normal pack - which is exactly how the engine applies them.
assumptions.howToChange: Edit godPack.rate, or set godPack.enabled to false.

Card list, rarities and card images
